notes: The selected reading r01 (SBLGNT.MAT.17.22.v021) is what 'while they abode' renders; the ASV's own margin records the competing 'were gathering themselves together', which corroborates the selection without licensing a new textual decision (rule 12).
'be delivered up' keeps its particle inside the verb's unit headed on the lexical verb (rules 17, 106); χεῖρας is anarthrous and its supplied 'the' is a rule 7/51 helper on the noun.
The articles before Γαλιλαίᾳ and Ἰησοῦς and the genitive τοῦ ἀνθρώπου are unrepresented, the ASV writing no determiner for any of them (rules 21, 23).
